title: רב ששנא

paragraphs: Rav Shashna—so in Rif—the son of R' Shmuel bar Avdumi. He was to be circumcised on Shabbat, but they forgot to bring a knife. They asked R' Mani and R' Yitzhak ben Elazar, and it was deferred to Sunday. In Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of R' Eliezer de-Milah, “Rav Shasha'ah” is a scribal error.
